market_question: Will Trump endorse María Corina Machado for Venezuela president in 2026?
reasoning: Trump rarely endorses foreign presidential candidates years in advance; his past Venezuela focus was on Guaidó. María Corina Machado is barred from office, and it's unclear she would be the main opposition figure in 2026. The market's 15.5% implied probability overrates a highly contingent political gesture.
evidence_points: Trump historically endorsed Juan Guaidó as interim president in 2019 but has not endorsed other specific Venezuelan candidates.
Machado won the 2023 opposition primary but was disqualified by Venezuelan authorities, making her an unlikely consensus candidate.
The 2026 election date is speculative; Venezuela’s next scheduled presidential election is 2024, and any rescheduling is uncertain.
sources_consulted: Reuters – US stance on Venezuela opposition
